links.comparator_used: Audio LLM prompted without chain-of-thought (direct answer), with bias measured across voice profiles
links.outcome: Voice-based demographic bias in surgical recommendations (gender, age, emotion)
links.effect: Explicit reasoning eliminated gender bias; age disparities of up to 12% between young and elderly voices persisted in most models despite chain-of-thought prompting; emotion effect could not be detected because emotion recognition was poor
links.quote: While explicit reasoning successfully eliminated gender bias, the impact of emotion was not detected due to poor recognition performance.
